def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    beginning_inventory_units = 200
    beginning_inventory_cost = 1250.00

    may_4_units = 20
    may_4_unit_cost = 5.80

    may_17_units = 80
    may_17_unit_cost = 5.50

    units_sold = 10

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    total_units_available = beginning_inventory_units + may_4_units + may_17_units
    total_inventory_cost = (
        beginning_inventory_cost
        + may_4_units * may_4_unit_cost
        + may_17_units * may_17_unit_cost
    )

    weighted_average_cost = total_inventory_cost / total_units_available
    weighted_average_cogs = weighted_average_cost * units_sold

    # return answer
    return round(weighted_average_cogs, 2)
